title: dedicated-autoscaler: improve priority routing, burst controls, and utilization reporting
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Improves priority-based routing for Dedicated autoscaler, smooths token-bucket burst behavior, and expands utilization reporting (new p50/p95 queue latency and token-utilization metrics). Backwards-compatible config additions; console dashboard updated.
description:
Context: Customers running Dedicated fleets with mixed-priority workloads saw head-of-line blocking and noisy autoscaler behavior during short bursts. This PR improves priority routing in the fleet autoscaler, smooths token-bucket burst controls to avoid oscillation, and expands utilization reporting so operators can debug tail latency and token consumption per-priority. Motivation: make throughput guarantees more predictable for multi-tenant Dedicated fleets and provide better observability for SREs and customers.

What this change does: 1) Priority routing: autoscaler now exposes per-priority token buckets and uses a weighted deficit scheduler when capacity is constrained; routing decisions prefer higher-priority pools but allow controlled spillover. 2) Burst smoothing: token-bucket refill/smoothing logic adjusted to reduce spike-driven scale-ups; introduces "burst_smoothing_ms" config with a sane default. 3) Utilization reporting: new metrics (dedicated.autoscaler.priority.token_utilization, dedicated.autoscaler.priority.queue_p50_ms, dedicated.autoscaler.priority.queue_p95_ms) and improvements to existing reporting to include in-console breakdown and fleet-level CSV export. 4) Backwards compatibility: config fields are additive; defaults preserve current behavior. 5) Tests and dashboards: adds unit and integration tests for scheduler fairness and updates the console dashboard JSON.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc: Linear ENG-4821 linked - [x] Unit tests for scheduling and smoothing - [x] Integration test with local simulated fleet - [x] Dashboard update and docs - [x] CI green

Migration notes: Operators can opt into per-priority token buckets by setting `autoscaler.priority_token_buckets.enabled = true`. When enabled, the autoscaler will create per-priority buckets with default rates derived from existing fleet weights. Operators should monitor `dedicated.autoscaler.priority.token_utilization` for 24-48h after enabling to tune rates.

Files touched: see summary below.

Why this is safe: The change is additive and guarded behind a feature flag. The smoothing defaults maintain previous refill timing. Metrics names are new and avoid collisions. Unit/integration tests cover edge cases (empty-workload, sustained-burst, priority-inversion scenarios).

Related: PRs that iterated on burst controls and reporting: pr-21437, pr-61234, pr-998765 (historical context).

review_comments: Marco Diaz: Can we add a unit test that simulates a priority inversion (low-priority hogging tokens) to validate the spillover behavior?
Aisha Kumar (author): Added scheduler_test.go case 'priority_inversion_recovery' that asserts higher-priority fairness after spillover. See latest commit.
Elena Petrova: Metric cardinality concern: per-priority tags could explode for customers with dynamic priorities. Can we cap cardinality or provide a sampling option?
Aisha Kumar: We added a config 'metrics.priority_cardinality_limit' (default=50) and emit 'priority=unknown' for over-limit labels; documented in docs.
Samir Patel: CI failed on first run in integration due to timing flake. Please ensure the integration test uses deterministic timing or increased timeout.
Aisha Kumar: Increased simulated-burst timeout and replaced sleep-based assertions with event hooks; CI rerun passed.
Marco Diaz (approval): LGTM after addressing tests and cardinality limit. Approving for squash and merge.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag off by default. To enable per-priority token buckets: set autoscaler.priority_token_buckets.enabled=true and optionally tune autoscaler.priority_token_buckets.burst_smoothing_ms. Watch metrics dedicated.autoscaler.priority.token_utilization and dedicated.autoscaler.priority.queue_p95_ms for adjustments.
changelog_entry: Improved Dedicated autoscaler: priority-aware routing, smoother burst controls, and expanded utilization metrics for better SLO observability. (Config additive; opt-in via autoscaler.priority_token_buckets.enabled)
